# docc ingest evaluation baseline — `task test:eval -- -update`
#
# Recall is the number to trust: the ground truth is every word the document
# is known to contain. Precision has a floor below 1 that is not the model's
# fault — the theme prints boilerplate that is on the page and in no source.
# Wall time is not recorded; it changes for reasons unrelated to any change
# under test.
# The chat rows are absent on purpose: the ones recorded before the scoring
# fixes understated precision, and a row measured by a different scorer reads
# as a permanent improvement that can never fire. Re-record them with
#   task test:eval -- -update -backends chat -models <model>
mineru/mineru-pro-2605 vision-only precision=0.817 recall=0.988 f1=0.894 rz=4/4 breaks=0 headings=8/8 pagenumbers=0 letterheads=1
